# Japan Welcomes You

> > Your comprehensive guide to curated travel experiences, cultural activities, and transportation services across Japan's major destinations including Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and beyond.

Japan Welcomes You offers travelers a carefully selected collection of authentic Japanese experiences, from traditional cultural activities like Zen meditation and kimono wearing to practical airport transfers and private guided tours. The site specializes in connecting visitors with unique experiences and reliable transportation services throughout Japan's key cities and regions.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo tours and experiences
- Kyoto cultural activities
- Osaka sightseeing
- Airport transfers (Narita, Haneda, Kansai)
- Private guided tours
- Traditional Japanese experiences
- Shinto ceremonies and temples
- Kimono experiences
- Zen meditation
- Japanese cooking classes
- Hotel pickup services
- Cruise port transfers
- Cultural workshops
- Nature tours
- Professional photography sessions

## Cultural & Traditional Experiences

- [Private Worship Ceremony And Guided Tour At Kanda Shrine In Tokyo](https://www.japanwelcomesyou.com/private-worship-ceremony-and-guided-tour-at-kanda-shrine-in-tokyo): Private Shinto worship ceremony & guided tour at Kanda Shrine, Tokyo
- [Experience Zen Meditation Or Sutra Copying, And Enjoy Vegetarian Food With Monk](https://www.japanwelcomesyou.com/experience-zen-meditation-or-sutra-copying-and-enjoy-vegetarian-food-with-monk): Zen meditation, sutra copying & vegetarian meal with monk near Mt. Aso
- [Roppongi Japanese Kimono Experience](https://www.japanwelcomesyou.com/roppongi-japanese-kimono-experience): Traditional kimono rental & wearing experience in Roppongi, Tokyo
- [2-Hour Japanese Lunch Cooking Guided Class In Kagurazaka](https://www.japanwelcomesyou.com/2-hour-japanese-lunch-cooking-guided-class-in-kagurazaka): 2-hour Japanese cooking class in Kagurazaka, Tokyo with lunch
- [Private Class Build Your Taiki Bamboo Lantern In Taiki](https://www.japanwelcomesyou.com/private-class-build-your-taiki-bamboo-lantern-in-taiki): Private workshop to build traditional Taiki bamboo lanterns in Mie
